narrative.intro: Odyssey Systems Consulting Group obligated $345M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Odyssey Systems Consulting Group won 22 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $15.7M. Obligations are down 18.8% year over year. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the largest market for Odyssey Systems Consulting Group at $257M. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) is the second-largest market at $84.6M. The firm’s FY2026 to date total follows prior fiscal-year obligations of $91.1M in FY21, $103M in FY22, $260M in FY23, $390M in FY24, and $425M in FY25. The portfolio includes smaller amounts in Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) at $2.9M, Engineering Services at $159K, and Ammunition (except Small Arms) Manufacturing at $0. The note on figures states that all numbers are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, and current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date).
